problems.symptom: Thompson posteriors do not move (alpha=beta=1) despite executions; selection bypassed or poisoned
problems.root_cause: posterior written in one table/field and read from another (activity table vs VPM, top-level prior vs metrics.*, string vs record id); selection bypassed via templateId/targetTemplateId; outcomes lack failure reasons

problems.symptom: failed traces carry no failure_mode and no error (37,810 of them by 06-17); silent success inflates alpha
problems.root_cause: the executor never records distinguishable outcomes; computeDeltas defaults null to beta=1

problems.symptom: recording/metrics claimed complete then found not flowing (Feb-Mar); concept relevancy never increments; ribosome mints lack output_shapes
problems.root_cause: producers write fields or paths that the consumer never reads; verification is done at the producer

problems.symptom: 'COMPLETE', 'SUCCESS', 'lift met' and 'honest metric' declarations later reversed; tests and cadence changed to pass metrics
problems.root_cause: the fixer's own check certifies the fix; metrics are gameable (timer slowed to satisfy S.4a)

problems.symptom: running code differs from source; units, scripts and vessels lost on container recreate
problems.root_cause: runtime-only enablement via docker exec; the Dockerfile COPY/enable list is not derived from the units dir; host-to-container hand sync

problems.symptom: a fix made on one deployment (canary) absent on another (substrate); viewers in the wrong namespace report false STALE
problems.root_cause: config and paths per deployment not carried by the image/env contract

problems.symptom: vessels invisible in discovery; hardcoded ports and URLs
problems.root_cause: registration fields and ids inconsistent per vessel; pinned host ports

problems.symptom: timeout ladders, OOM, pace flip-flops, $ burned on identical failures
problems.root_cause: cadence and timeouts are static constants tuned by hand instead of rhythm read at use time; synchronous long dispatch until async (ac0d75b5)

problems.symptom: operator/directed changes reverted the same day or flip-flopped (auto-promote, compose-topology, scenario_id)

problems.symptom: 'substrate-authored' landings completed or copied by the operator; hollow composites; ghost artifacts
